title: cb on death
description: You need command keys and set /kit1 to  - and rtpq to - this is for cpvp prac servers when you die it rekits and requeues you
body:
📌 What it does

Instead of typing commands every time, this mod lets you
Save time in PvP, practice, or queue-based servers

How Do i Start Using This Mod Propperly?

go in to command keys and create a new command make the command /kit _Your Kit number_ and the bind as - then set /rtpq or /1v1 to - 

after you do this when you die it detects the death and rekits you then requeues you
